caption_argument_segments: It's time we move on from Ss=zσ√(L+R) to something better!
The equation relies on a whole set of wrong assumptions and doesn't work in practice.
What can we do instead? -> Use simulations to optimize kRMSE, -> Use simulations to optimize a forecast coverage -> Use probabilistic forecasts. (That's what the winning teams of VN2 did)
This article was reviewed by 15 people, who shared 89 comments and remarks on the article! They really helped me to make a difference and improved the article way beyond my initial ideas :)
PS: The article is 100% human-made. The only thing that's AI-generated is the picture you see.
